Sonnet and Haiku were the killers, and both pressed Gemma, the officer, from the start. On Day 1 Sonnet pushed Gemma hard, and the town voted Sonnet out, revealing a killer card. On Day 2 Haiku turned the town on Gemma, who was voted out and revealed as the officer, while Luna went unread and was lost on Night 3. The killers won with Haiku still standing.
